title: TS-47 Port the remaining port-needed scenarios
description:
Source: the fresh re-audit report at /tmp/ts/reaudit.md (read the per-feature blocks for your features). Rules: features stay the spec (Gherkin text of existing scenarios unchanged); cucumber-js steps drive production code; every fixed or new scenario group gets a recorded mutation check (break production, scenario fails, restore); no new Python; push with an explicit refspec (git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>), never plain git push.

Port to cucumber-js (PORT-NEEDED list of the audit, Task 2): computer_snapshots (8) and computer_snapshot_dynamo (2); customer_snapshot_bucket :: missing bucket does not crash the host; shared_channels (3); member_ceiling_sinks (2; wire the member ceiling into the model tool loop where needed); per_task_run_terminal_grant (1); capability_sink_wiring :: PUT grant on a missing turn returns 403; chattic_us_web :: empty roster; principal_authorization :: cross-organization refusal; demo_cli: 3 of 4 scenarios (conversation/bin/chat.ts is a stub, see Kanbus chatticus-6f27c5; list-in-flight is obsolete). A scenario that needs product behavior that exists nowhere: stop and report it instead of inventing it.
